negative_controls.description: One planted mutation per gate, matched to the exact defect class the gate's own docstring says it detects, must turn the gate RED (non-zero exit) inside the scratch worktree.
After reverting the planted mutation in the same scratch worktree instance, the gate must return to exit 0 -- proving the RED came from the mutation, not from scratch-tree contamination.
The sweep must never write to the live tree; every mutation and its revert happen inside a disposable `git worktree add --detach` checkout, removed at the end of the run.

report.headline: 24 gates present in the AUD-0041/AUD-0045 inventory; 8 swept end-to-end this pass with a mutation matched to the exact defect class each gate's own docstring names -- 8/8 confirmed baseline=0, mutated=non-zero, AND reverted=0 in the same scratch worktree instance; 16 gates carried forward as not-yet-swept residuals.
